rule.name: HostPortColonSplit
rule.message: This cuts a host and port at ":". An IPv6 literal such as [::1]:3000 has colons of its own, so the host becomes "[" and the port is lost or wrong. Parse it with URI (new URI("http://" + host).getHost() and getPort()), Guava HostAndPort.fromString(host), or cut after the closing bracket. A value that is known not to be an IPv6 address takes an exceptions entry.
